# ethereum-optimism/op-geth Daily Update (Apr 28, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day's activity focused on updating the Superchain Registry, incorporating a new field for safer safes addresses. Additionally, two significant issues were closed, addressing a CI test crash and the implementation of a bundle canonicalization process.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

*   **Superchain Registry Update**
    *   Updated the `superchain-registry` to commit `cc07e96d91a1647cbce7eef6572098bece1f7fca`, including a new `safer_safes_addr` field [#788](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/788).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
No new pull requests were opened today.

## CLOSED ISSUES

*   **CI Test Stability Improvements**
    *   The `kona-host-client-offline-cannon` test crash due to an incorrect target specification in `cannon-builder:v1.0.0` was resolved. The fix involved bind-mounting a corrected `mips64-unknown-none.json` and refreshing the committed witness tar [#19895](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/19895).
*   **L2CM Upgrade Process Finalization**
    *   The implementation of the Bundle Canonicalization process for L2CM Upgrades has been completed, allowing for manual triggers to update bundled NUTs per hardfork with automated CI checks [#19307](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/19307).

## NEW ISSUES
No new issues were reported today.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

*   **`op-alloy` Trait Conflict**
    *   Users are encountering conflicting implementations of the `alloy_network::NetworkWallet<Optimism>` trait for `alloy_network::EthereumWallet` [#20281](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/20281). The issue stems from an unreleased `op-alloy` version on crates.io, despite a fix being merged in a related repository. A recent comment questions if `op-alloy` is still actively maintained by Optimism.
